name: sqlite-snapshot-correctness-canary-v1
randomness: none; fixed literal rows and ordered barriers
limitations: A known SQLite primitive correctness canary, not a novel backup algorithm or a packaged Gateway reproduction.
Generic context/message/receipt rows contain no actual provider request or external business effect.
The writer is quiescent at explicit barriers; no sustained concurrent writers, lock stress or backup performance claim.
Hard process exit is not power loss, disk corruption, torn writes or storage durability certification.
Two fresh read-only reopenings establish these literal snapshots only, not general liveness or production reliability.
integrity_check=ok is structural validity, not evidence of snapshot freshness or application completeness.
